frac_rule: min(16, 29 - ceil(log2(absmax))); X covers X and XN; S from S_centered; QKV covers K_centered; QKV and K_centered are the smoothed maxima; LOGITS fixed at 16

k_centering_gate.metric: rel: rms(q.k_int8 - q.k) / rms(q.k); log2: error of q.k / sqrt(d) * log2(e); both over the causal window; raw K, centered K, and centered K divided by the smoothing factors

qk_smoothing.fold: rows d and d + head_dim/2 of W_k, b_k and the K-centering row divided by s_p; the same rows of W_q, b_q of every served query head multiplied by s_p
qk_smoothing.rule: s_p = (max|k_c|_p / max|q|_p)^alpha over the calibration tokens, both dimensions of the pair and the query heads the KV head serves (k_c: centered post-RoPE K; q: post-RoPE Q); per (layer, KV head) divided by the geometric mean; clipped to [1/cap, cap]; rounded to `digits` significant digits
